log.decision: Scripted (code-drawn) walkers removed; the hand-drawn traveler is the only character. Portal now leads with a live progress section.
log.progress: 'Live now' shows the traveler walking on hand-drawn grass plus the latest world screenshot; every portal section refreshes itself every 10s.

log.decision: Playtest fixes: lighthouse base is solid and y-sorted; all water impassable (feet hitbox) and rock edges facing the sea are cliffs; rectangular east spur clipped; dirt path rebuilt as a connected 2-tile-wide path with orthogonal turns (one dirt image per aligned 2x2 block, rotated 90deg for horizontal runs, pixels untouched); tighter tree-trunk collision; rock seam lines removed; favicon added. Every world build now updates the portal.
log.progress: Removed characters cleared from animation/sprites.json; portal Live section shows this build's status. Corners/junctions still need hand-drawn path corner and T tiles.

log.decision: Director added Branch 3 (Gameplay art): Artist 3 and Checker 3, taking item/NPC/prop requests from Game Designer, gameplay art first. Same rule: pixels clicked in Ryan's app, exported via its PNG button.
log.progress: Branch 3 chat created; awaiting Game Designer's first list.

log.decision: Art rule loosened by Ryan: any PNG exported from his app counts. Branch 2 grass v2-v7 mixed into the ground with the base grass (seeded, stable per 2x2 block). Director import rule: every imported 512px tile gets a native 32x32 copy in world/assets made by sampling each 16px block's centre and snapping to the painted palette; branch PNGs untouched.
log.progress: Dirt v3 and grass v2-v7 imported as native 32x32 (dirt clean, 8 colours; grass 3 colours each). Dirt rotated clockwise for horizontal runs. East-tip dark cliff stripe removed. No Branch 2 path-corner, water, tree, bush or rock tiles exist yet; tile_grass_b v1-v2 exist but were not requested.

log.decision: Approved Branch 2 path corners (ne, es, sw, wn) and T-junction (t_n, opens W/E/S) v1, tree v1, grass_b v1/v2 and Branch 1 traveler walk-right v2 are now in the world; all imported as native 32x32 centre-sampled, palette-snapped copies (world/snap.py), sources untouched.
log.progress: Path re-laid so every turn/junction is a supported shape and picks its art from neighbouring blocks; trees use tree v1 (grass background cut by a hull mask) with the same collision and y-sort; traveler walk-right frames via animation/traveler.py, left mirrored, up/down fall back to the static sprite. Fixed a portal crash (REFS used before declaration). shoot.py adds traveler_walk_lr.gif.

log.decision: Branch 2 water v1, water shore v2 and rock v3 in the world (native 32x32 via snap.py, sources untouched).
log.progress: Water v1 renders the sea and pond (2x2 tiles per image) under the existing surf/sparkle; shore v2 (unrotated) on pond tiles with grass directly above; rock v3 is a boulder on grass, so it's used as solid, y-sorted boulder props (grass cut out) on the headland and meadow rather than as headland ground, which stays placeholder grey. Collision kept.

log.decision: Swapped in latest Branch 2 art: tree v3 (newest available; v2 superseded), bush v1, path bends v2 (ne/es/sw/wn/t_n).
log.progress: world/import_tiles.py picks the highest v per tile, snaps to native 32x32 and hull-masks sprites; 26 solid, y-sorted bushes added (the world had no placeholder bushes). Zero console errors.

log.decision: Routine check: swapped in the newest Branch 2 art that landed after the 13:28 build: bush v2, rock v4 (boulders), water v2 and water shore v3.
log.progress: Native 32x32 snapped copies via world/import_tiles.py + snap.py, sources untouched; rock re-cut from its grass background. Playtest script clean (zero console errors, never ends on water). Still waiting on hand-drawn art for: traveler walk up/down frames, fox walk frames (fox v1/v2 are stills), deer (none yet), hero robin walk frames (robin_hero v1-v3 are stills).

log.decision: Score-9 art in the world: water v2 + water b v1 (seeded per-block mix), water shore v4, tree v4, final bush v4 from Branch 3.

log.decision: Final rock v6 used for all boulders (it is a single boulder, so the headland ground stays placeholder grey). Sea favours fish-free water_b; full water v2/water_b tiles with fish kept to ~10% of open sea. Pond shores use shore v4 (grass N), shore_n v1 (grass S), shore_e v2 (grass W), shore_w v2 (grass E).
log.progress: import_tiles.py now covers rock and shore_e/w/n. Pond corners still use a side tile until the corner (oc_*) tiles pass. Zero console errors.

log.decision: Routine check: pond corner shores swapped into the world. Convex corners use outer oc tl/tr/bl/br v4 mixed per tile with oc se/sw/ne/nw v2 (the same corner drawn a second way). Concave corners use inner ic tl/tr/bl/br v2. Side shores mix shore_e/w v2 with the new shore_e_b/w_b v1 per 2x2 block. Water is now v3 and water_b v2.
log.progress: index.html now picks each pond tile from its neighbours (two land sides = outer corner, land only on a diagonal = inner corner, otherwise a side tile) and samples corner tiles from their centred 16px square. Corners join the side shores with no seams (shots/routine_1345_pond_corners.png). Water still can't be walked on. Playtest shoot.py: zero console errors, ended on water 0. Still waiting on traveler walk up/down frames, fox walk frames, deer, and hero robin walk frames.

log.decision: Traveler is 8-way (Ryan): diagonal input moves at normalized speed; directions down/up/right/left/downright/upright/downleft/upleft with left-side mirrors.
